text: あしもとに　ちゅうもく　して　みたかい？

structure.jp: ちゅうもく　して　みたかい？

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: ちゅうもく　して　みた
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means to try doing it and see what happens. ちゅうもく　して　みた = 'tried paying attention'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい at the end is a friendly, slightly old-fashioned man's way of asking a yes-or-no question. みたかい = 'did you try?'.
